comment: Nova Chaser (champion an Elemental, CR 702.72) -- the POST-COMBAT champion line. T3 with five Mountains, Spark Elemental (3/1 trample haste, sacrificed at each end step) and Nova Chaser (10/2 trample, no haste) in hand, the opponent at 21, nothing else to draw. Only Spark attacking T3 (3) and Nova cast in MAIN 2 championing the already-attacked, doomed Spark keeps both the 3 damage and the 10/2 (T4 10, T5 10 = 23 >= 21: win T5). Nova pre-combat would have to champion the Spark before it attacks (20 by T5: T6) or champion nothing and be sacrificed. Needs a searched second main (GoldFishRunner::DeckUsesSecondMain reads champion_subtype) and the champion pick searched (ChampionVariantTargets -> Action::enchant_target). The Spark stays in exile (Nova never leaves).
